profile.headline: Software Engineer at wikiHow
profile.summary: Aaron Gutierrez is a software engineer at WikiHow, which is a website focused on creating a collaborative how-to guide for anything.  Previously, he was the founding engineer at Happiness Engines, a startup focused on consumer software.  He also worked previously for EA and startups that focused on creating social games. He is responsible for technical product development, technical operations, and full stack software development for desktop, iOS and web applications.

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed and Launched Colorized, which was featured in the app store three times and had over 100k downloads.
* Developed and launched Happiness Engines, a software personal assistant.

positions.title: Senior Server Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for software design, implementation, and test for server and client side software for the social game division of EA, which was previously Playfish. 
* Wrote server side code for The Sims Social, a facebook game which had over 1.5mm daily active users.
* Wrote server side code for Monopoly Millionaires, a facebook game which had over 700k daily active users.

positions.title: Senior Technical Lead
positions.description: * Designed/developed a web product that personalized your news.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Client and Server side development for vside.com, a 3D virtual world for Mac and PC which let you listen to music and interact with friends.
* Developed the games audio tools.
* Conceived and created a live broadcast radio for an MMO game on top of my normal work responsibilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for development of software for the music production division of JBL Pro.  This division created loudspeakers for music producers doing surround sound mixes for movies and recording artists.   
* Created the software that allowed control of the surround sound speakers from a PC.
* Worked with the hardware engineers to integrated their new subwoofer into this line and shipped it.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: * Responsible for software design, and development of embedded C++ software on the F-35 Lightning II stealth fighter plane.
